description.value: Established in 1984, Granville Island Brewing operates this taproom on Granville Island where visitors can sample the full core lineup alongside exclusive small-batch Taproom Series releases brewed on-site — beers unavailable anywhere else. The taproom offers indoor and outdoor patio seating with a food menu, dogs are welcome on the patio and brewery entrance, and the space is wheelchair accessible via a side-door ramp.
